build artifacts concept
Build artifacts are the files produced by a software build process, such as compiled programs, packages, logs, or test outputs.
bulgaria
Bulgaria is a European country that may appear in cybersecurity reporting as a location, target, or law-enforcement context.

business-email-compromise technique

also: C3RB3R ransomware
canada
Canada is a North American country often referenced in cybersecurity reporting as a target, regulator, or law-enforcement partner.
capture concept
A capture is a part of a regular expression that saves matched text so it can be reused or referenced later.
Capture the Flag concept
Capture the Flag is a cybersecurity game or competition where participants solve security challenges to find hidden proof strings called flags.
Cathay Pacific organization
A Hong Kong-based international airline.

chat message concept
A message sent through a chat or messaging service.

A Microsoft Graph application permission that allows an app to read all Teams chat messages it is authorized to access.

A Microsoft Graph delegated permission that allows an app to read and modify a signed-in user's Teams chats.

Check Point is a cybersecurity company known for firewall, network security, cloud security, and threat prevention products.
Check Point Research organization
Check Point Research is the threat intelligence and research team of Check Point Software Technologies.
Check Point Research organization
Check Point Research is the threat intelligence and research team of cybersecurity company Check Point.
Chestny Znak organization
A Russian national system for tracking and labeling goods.
china
China is a country often referenced in cybersecurity reporting involving technology, espionage, regulation, and threat activity.

A Chinese-speaking threat actor is an attacker or group described as using Chinese language or infrastructure clues in security reporting.
Chrome product
A popular web browser developed by Google, frequently targeted by exploit kits and phishing campaigns.
Chrome App-Bound Encryption technique
Chrome App-Bound Encryption is a Google Chrome protection that ties saved secrets to the Chrome app to make theft harder.
Chrome for Android product
Google's Chrome web browser for Android phones and tablets.
Chrome’s App-Bound Encryption technique
Chrome’s App-Bound Encryption is a Google Chrome protection that ties saved secrets to the Chrome app to make theft harder.
CI concept
A software development practice where code changes are regularly merged and tested automatically.
CI runner tool
A CI runner is a computer or service that automatically runs build, test, or deployment jobs for software projects.
CI/CD pipelines concept
CI/CD pipelines are automated processes used to build, test, and deploy software changes.
also: continuous integration (CI)

also: US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, CISA's phishing guidance

claude
Claude is Anthropic’s family of AI assistants and language models.
Claude model product
An AI language model made by Anthropic that can generate and analyze text and code.
CLI concept
A CLI is a text-based way to control a computer or program by typing commands.
cloud concept
The cloud is internet-based computing where data and applications run on remote servers instead of only on your own device.

Secret credentials that allow software or people to access cloud accounts and services.
Cloud accounts concept
Cloud accounts are identities or subscriptions used to access services hosted by providers like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Cloud credentials concept
Cloud credentials are passwords, keys, or tokens used to access cloud services and resources.
Cloud data concept
Data stored in online services run on remote servers rather than only on a local device.
cloud infrastructure concept
Cloud infrastructure is computing infrastructure provided through internet-based services.
cloud platforms product
Cloud platforms are online computing services that provide servers, storage, databases, and other infrastructure over the internet.
cloud services concept
Computing resources—like storage, apps, and networking—delivered over the internet by providers such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
cloud storage concept
Cloud storage is saving files on internet-based servers instead of only on a local device.
Cloud Sync Service product
Cloud Sync Service is a named software service that suggests syncing data between a device and cloud storage.
cloud systems concept
Cloud systems are computer services and data storage run on internet-connected servers instead of only on a person's or company's own machines.
cloudflare
Cloudflare is a company that provides content delivery, DDoS protection, DNS, and web security services.
Cloudflare Security Analytics product
Cloudflare Security Analytics is a Cloudflare feature for reviewing and investigating security events in web and network traffic.
Cloudflare Turnstile product
A user-friendly CAPTCHA alternative by Cloudflare that verifies humans without puzzles, preserving privacy.
Cloudflare WAF product
Cloudflare WAF is Cloudflare's web application firewall that helps block malicious web traffic before it reaches a website.

CloudSEK is a cybersecurity company that monitors online threats, leaked data, and criminal activity on the internet.
code execution technique
Code execution means an attacker can make a computer or server run commands or software of their choosing.
CodeAnt AI organization
An organization that provides AI-assisted code security analysis.
CodeAnt AI Security Research Team organization
A security research team associated with CodeAnt AI.
codex
Codex is an OpenAI AI coding model or coding assistant technology for helping write and understand code.
codex-x product
An AI coding package or service referenced in security reporting.
coinbase-wallet product
Coinbase Wallet is a cryptocurrency wallet app used to store and manage crypto assets and tokens.
Command-and-control server concept
Remote computers controlled by attackers that send orders to infected devices and collect stolen data.
commercial models concept
Commercial models are business approaches for selling or providing a product or service, such as subscriptions or pay-per-use access.
commit concept
A saved set of changes in a version-control system such as Git.
Common framework concept
A common framework is a shared way to organize, compare, or handle information so different teams can work from the same playbook.
Company Servers concept
Computers operated by an organization to store data or provide services to users and other systems.
compromise concept
A compromise is a situation where a system, account, or data has been breached or taken over by an attacker.
compromised concept
Compromised means a system, account, or device has been accessed or controlled by someone who should not have access.
compromised accounts concept
Compromised accounts are user accounts that attackers have gained access to without permission.
compromised computers concept
Compromised computers are devices that attackers have gained unauthorized access to or control over.
compromised sites concept
Compromised sites are legitimate websites that attackers have broken into and may use to host scams, malware, or redirects.
Compromised systems concept
Compromised systems are computers, servers, or devices that an attacker has successfully broken into or controlled.
compromised website concept
A legitimate site that has been hacked and may host malicious content or redirect visitors to phishing pages.
compromised websites concept
Compromised websites are legitimate websites that attackers have broken into and changed or abused for malicious purposes.
Computer equipment product
Computer equipment means physical technology such as laptops, servers, drives, routers, and other hardware.
computer networks concept
Computer networks are groups of connected devices that can share data with each other.
Computing Resources concept
The processing power, memory, storage, and network capacity used to run digital services.
Confidence concept
Confidence is a measure of how certain a security team is that an alert or finding is truly malicious.
confidential information concept
Confidential information is private or sensitive data that should only be shared with authorized people.
configuration files concept
Configuration files are files that store settings telling software or systems how to behave.
configuration management concept
The process of setting, tracking, and controlling computer and software settings so systems stay consistent and secure.
conspiracy concept
Conspiracy is an agreement between people to commit an unlawful act.
Contact Details concept
Information used to contact a person, such as an address, email address, or phone number.
container images concept
Container images are packaged snapshots of an application and its needed files that can be run consistently in container environments.
also: minimal container images, hardened container images
containment technique
Containment is the process of limiting a cyber incident so attackers or malware cannot spread further.
Content Delivery Network concept
A Content Delivery Network is a group of servers that deliver websites and files faster by serving them from locations near users.
Context.ai product
An AI software service referenced in security reporting.
continuous concept
In security, continuous means something is monitored or updated all the time instead of only during occasional checks.
control panel product
A control panel is an interface used to manage settings, accounts, systems, or services.
Control systems concept
Control systems are computers and devices that monitor or operate physical equipment such as machines, valves, or production lines.
Controller concept
A controller is a component that manages or directs how other parts of a system behave.
cookie concept
A cookie is a small piece of data a website stores in a browser to remember things like logins, preferences, or tracking information.
cookie theft technique
Cookie theft is when attackers steal browser cookies so they can impersonate someone without needing the password.
cookies concept
Cookies are small pieces of data websites store in a browser to remember logins, settings, or tracking information.
Cooling Systems concept
Equipment that removes heat to keep food, rooms, or machinery cold.
Coolworld Rentals organization
A company that rents refrigeration and temperature-control equipment.
coordination concept
Coordination is the organized sharing of tasks, information, and decisions among people or teams.
Copeland organization

Copilot is Microsoft's AI assistant built into various Microsoft products to help with tasks like writing, searching, and coding.
Core Werewolf threat-actor
A threat-actor group referenced in security reporting.
Coruna malware
Coruna is a named malware family, cyber tool, or threat label referenced in security reporting.
Cracking technique
The attempt to break passwords, encryption, or other protections to gain access to data or systems.
crafted file technique
A crafted file is a specially made file designed to trigger a bug, exploit a weakness, or test how software handles unusual input.
crafted HTTP requests technique
Crafted HTTP requests are deliberately modified web requests sent to test, exploit, or trigger unusual behavior in a web server or application.
crawlers tool
Automated programs that visit and inspect webpages, often for search indexing or security scanning.
credential concept
A credential is proof of identity for logging in, such as a password, security token, API key, or certificate.
Credential compromise concept
Credential compromise means a password, token, or key has been stolen or exposed so someone unauthorized can log in.
credential exposure concept
Credential exposure means usernames, passwords, keys, or tokens have been revealed where attackers may be able to use them.

Credential rotation means replacing passwords, keys, or tokens with new ones to reduce the risk from stolen or old credentials.

credential theft technique
Credential theft is the stealing of usernames, passwords, tokens, or other login information.
credentials concept
Credentials are login details or access tokens that prove a user or system is allowed to access something.
Critical Breach Vector concept
An important route or weakness that attackers could use to enter a system or cause a security incident.
critical findings concept
Critical findings are serious security issues that need urgent attention because they could cause major harm.
critical issues concept
Critical issues are problems considered urgent because they can cause major harm, such as system compromise or serious service disruption.
CRM concept

cryptocurrency concept
Cryptocurrency is digital money, such as Bitcoin, that uses cryptography and usually runs on a blockchain.
also: crypto
cryptocurrency thefts concept
Cryptocurrency thefts are crimes where attackers steal digital currencies such as Bitcoin or Ethereum.
cryptocurrency wallet product
A cryptocurrency wallet is software or hardware used to store and use the keys that control digital coins.
cryptocurrency wallet data concept
Information about cryptocurrency wallets, including keys, balances, and transaction history, often targeted by thieves.
cryptocurrency wallets product
Cryptocurrency wallets are tools used to store and manage access to digital currency funds.
cryptojacking technique
Cryptojacking is when attackers secretly use someone else’s computer power to mine cryptocurrency.

Using computer processing power to generate cryptocurrency, often without the system owner's permission.
cryptomining software tool
Software that uses a computer's processing power to create or validate cryptocurrency transactions for rewards.
custom malware malware
Custom malware is malicious software specially built or modified for a particular attacker, target, or campaign.
Customer accounts concept
Customer accounts are user records and logins that let customers access a company's services.
customer data concept
Customer data is information a company keeps about its customers, such as names, contact details, or purchase history.
customer database concept
A customer database is a stored collection of information about an organization's customers.
Customer Records concept
Stored information about customers, such as names, account details, and contact information.
Customer Relationship Management concept
Customer relationship management is software or a business process for tracking customers, sales, support, and communications.
customer service concept
Customer service is the support an organization provides to help users or customers solve problems.

CVSS 9.1 concept
CVSS 9.1 is a high severity score on the Common Vulnerability Scoring System, meaning a security flaw is considered very serious.
CVSS score concept
A CVSS score is a standard number used to show how severe a software vulnerability is.
cyber concept
Cyber is a broad shorthand for things related to computers, networks, and digital security.
cyber incident concept
A cyber incident is any event where digital systems, accounts, or data may have been attacked, exposed, or disrupted.
cyber-enabled concept
Cyber-enabled means an activity is made possible or easier through computers, networks, or online services.
cyberattack concept
A cyberattack is an attempt to damage, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access to computer systems or data.
also: attack, Attacks like these
cyberattacks concept
Malicious activities conducted over computer networks to steal data, disrupt operations, or damage systems.
cybercrime concept
Cybercrime is crime carried out using computers, networks, or the internet.
Cybersecurity concept
Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting computers, networks, software, and data from digital attacks or misuse.
cybersecurity incident concept
A cybersecurity incident is an event that threatens the security of systems, networks, or data.
cybersecurity leaders concept
Cybersecurity leaders are people responsible for guiding an organization's security strategy and teams.
cybersecurity specialists concept
Cybersecurity specialists are professionals who help protect systems, investigate incidents, and reduce digital risks.
Danfoss organization

Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Controllers product
Danfoss devices used to monitor and control refrigeration and building-cooling equipment.

The dark web is a part of the internet that requires special tools to access and is often discussed in relation to hidden marketplaces and forums.
DarkSword malware
DarkSword is a named malware family, threat, or cyber tool referenced in security reporting.
DarkVigil malware
A named backdoor malware family that gives attackers remote access to infected systems.
data breaches concept
Data breaches happen when private or sensitive information is exposed, stolen, or accessed without permission.
Data collection concept
Data collection is the process of gathering information from people, systems, devices, or services for analysis or use.
data exfiltration technique
Data exfiltration is the unauthorized removal or copying of data from a system.
data extraction technique
The process of collecting or pulling information out of a device, system, or data source.
data governance concept
The rules, responsibilities, and processes an organization uses to manage data safely, accurately, and legally.
data integrity concept
The condition of data being accurate, complete, and protected from unauthorized alteration.
data loss concept
The accidental or unauthorized destruction, exposure, theft, or unavailability of data.
data recovery concept
Data recovery is the process of restoring lost, deleted, damaged, or inaccessible files or information.
Data sensitivity concept
Data sensitivity describes how carefully information must be protected based on the harm that could happen if it is exposed or changed.
data theft concept
Data theft is the stealing of information from a system or service.
Database Backups concept
Saved copies of a database that can be used to restore information after loss, damage, or an outage.
also: full database backups, stored system backups, exported backups, raw database snapshots

A well-known community-driven Linux distribution famous for its stability and package management system.
Debian 11 product
A release of the Debian Linux operating system.
Debian 12 product
Debian 12 is a version of the Debian Linux operating system, also known by the codename Bookworm.
debug.log other
A log file that stores detailed diagnostic messages produced by a program.
defenders concept
Defenders are the people or teams responsible for protecting systems and responding to cyber threats.
Delegated Graph Permissions protocol
Microsoft Graph permissions that let an application access data while acting on behalf of a signed-in user.
delegation chain concept
A record showing the original requester and each handoff of authority between agents before an action occurs.
deleted concept
Deleted means removed from normal access, though copies may sometimes still exist in backups, logs, or recovery areas.
denial-of-service condition concept
A denial-of-service condition is a situation where a system becomes unavailable or unusable for legitimate users.
Department of Justice organization
The main U.S. federal law enforcement agency responsible for prosecuting federal crimes and upholding justice.
dependencies concept
Dependencies are outside software components or libraries that an application needs in order to work.
dependency concept
A dependency is outside software that an application relies on, which can create risk if that outside component is vulnerable or malicious.
Detection gap concept
A detection gap is a weakness or blind spot that prevents security tools or teams from noticing certain malicious activity.
developer laptop product
A developer laptop is a computer used by a software developer for coding, testing, and related work.

Developer laptops are computers used by software developers to write, test, and manage code, which can make them valuable targets for attackers.

device configurations concept
Settings that control how a computer, network device, or application operates.
digital currency concept
Digital currency is money or value that exists electronically rather than as physical cash.
Direct Access concept
The ability to reach data or a system directly without using an intermediary service or workaround.

Disclosure is the act of reporting or publishing information about a security issue so it can be understood and fixed.

Discovery is the attacker activity of learning about a victim’s systems, accounts, and network before taking further action.

Disinformation concept
Disinformation is false or misleading information spread deliberately to deceive people.

disruption concept

domain controller concept

DreamHost organization
A web-hosting company that provides website, domain, email, and server services.

e-commerce sites product

Elevated means running with higher permissions than a normal user, such as administrator-level access.
email access concept
Email access means the ability to read, send, or manage someone’s email account, which attackers often want because it can unlock other services.
email addresses concept
